Why is the world struggling to fight climate change despite having the technology and solutions?

The discussion around COP31 highlights a major challenge in global climate action: conflicting economic interests, geopolitical tensions, fossil fuel dependency and disagreements over climate finance.

In this video, Kapil Bhardwaj Sir break down why climate negotiations are struggling to deliver meaningful outcomes and how different countries approach the climate crisis based on their economic priorities.

Having only five hours a day to study meant Abhijeet Jain had to make every hour count. He focused on using his limited time effectively. That also meant cutting down on distractions such as YouTube, Netflix and excessive mobile use. In this short, AIR 170 Abhijeet Jain shares how limited study time shaped his UPSC preparation and daily study choices.

Dr. Abhijeet Jain secured AIR 170 in UPSC CSE 2025 in his first attempt. He shares how he balanced his professional responsibilities with UPSC preparation and the strategies that helped him navigate the examination.

We celebrated our first anniversary in the Maldives, and it turned into one of the most heartfelt and adventurous trips we have filmed, full of ocean calm, big laughs and honest conversations about what a year together really feels like.

From slow mornings to days spent in and around the water, we stepped out of our comfort zone, tried new things together and soaked in the island life. Even the rain could not take away from the magic of the place.

We also look back at how our story began, what the first year has taught us, and why no relationship is ever perfect. We end the trip with a little anniversary celebration and a lot of gratitude.

This is just the beginning of our Life Of Rahi series. There is a lot more still to come, so keep following along.
